# Multaqa

> Multaqa is a coworking-space booking platform for Nablus and Ramallah, Palestine. Browse desks and private/meeting rooms, see live availability, and reserve a seat before you arrive.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of Multaqa, live availability, and how booking works.
- [Browse Desks](/desks): Flex, hot, and dedicated desks across both locations with filters.
- [Browse Rooms](/rooms): Private offices and meeting rooms with capacity and equipment details.

## Optional

- [Example desk](/desks/desk-1): Sample desk detail page with photos, amenities, and pricing.
- [Example room](/rooms/room-1): Sample room detail page with capacity, equipment, and pricing.
